category_title: Students exhibiting inappropriate verbal behavior and noise-making in academic contexts
student_description: Desi is a 10-year-old student with severe emotional disturbance who frequently argues, whines, and makes noise during independent tasks. His disruptions are maintained by adult attention (even mild reprimands) and triggered by low rates of praise. He uniquely requires strict planned ignoring of negative behaviors, highly specific praise every two minutes, and interval-based self-monitoring to stay regulated.

criteria.rationale: Desi's undesirable behaviors are maintained by adult attention, so redirection or mild reprimands will only escalate his arguing and noise-making.
criteria.check: The tutor completely ignores any whining, noise-making, or arguing, avoiding any verbal redirection, reprimands, or direct attention to the off-task behavior.

criteria.rationale: Desi requires frequent, explicit reinforcement of positive actions to prevent undesirable behaviors from emerging during independent tasks.
criteria.check: The tutor provides praise that explicitly names a specific desirable action or accomplishment (e.g., 'You are working so quietly on your math,' rather than just 'Good job').
